correctness.rationale: The Gram matrix (1/(2L))int_{a-L}^{a+L}v(x)v(x)^T dx has simple rank-one L=0 top eigenvalue rho=||v||^2>0, giving a uniform-in-a compact-set spectral perturbation expansion. Christoffel–Darboux yields rho(z)=-2rho(z) at every H_N zero, and decreasing E_N=h_N_prime^2+(2N+1-x^2)h_N^2 rules out higher local peaks globally. The perturbation coefficients include the crucial zero-eigenspace mixing term ||w||^2/36; exact finite ladder sum-by-parts yields mu1_prime(z)=0 and mu2_prime(z)=-z rho(z)/45. Implicit differentiation gives quadratic shift zero and quartic shift -z/90 for all zeros. Bounded derivatives and decay confine global optima to the top rho peaks; symmetry yields unique center zero for odd N and a pair for even N. Independently checked all Hermite-zero derivative coefficients at ranks <=8 (54 identities). Only fixed N and small L are proved.
